name: kikard
description: Detects hallucinated packages (slopsquatting), exposed secrets, and language-specific injection vulnerabilities in AI-generated code. Covers npm, PyPI, crates.io, Packagist, Go modules, RubyGems, and Maven locally -- plus an optional connected advanced scan (--advanced), an AI-generated code fix applicant (--ai-fix, preview + confirmation required), a free local fix-prompt generator (--fix-prompt, no network call, ready to paste into any AI assistant), and a local registry firewall (`kikard firewall start`) that blocks hallucinated/typosquatted npm and PyPI packages before native install commands complete.
